text: 提出残差学习框架，用不增加参数和计算量的恒等捷径连接让堆叠层拟合残差映射。

evidence.quote: In this paper, we address the degradation problem by introducing a deep residual learning framework.
Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.

text: 在 ImageNet 上训练深达 152 层的残差网络，深度为 VGG 的 8 倍但复杂度更低，集成模型在测试集上的 top-5 错误率为 3.57%。

evidence.quote: On the ImageNet dataset we evaluate residual nets with a depth of up to 152 layers—8× deeper than VGG nets [41] but still having lower complexity.
Our ensemble has 3.57% top-5 error on the 2 ImageNet test set, and won the 1st place in the ILSVRC 2015 classification competition.

text: 在 CIFAR-10 上分析 100 层与 1000 层以上的残差网络，并与 FitNet、Highway 比较。
